name: Injoku Sousa ~Futari no Joshikousei wa Boku no Iinari~
original_name: 淫辱操作～2人の女子校生は僕の言いなり～
source:
Masato Nanjo is a friendless, timid guy who is constantly bullied by girls in his class. He learns certain secrets about those girls and decides now is the time for revenge. But he's not confident enough to take direct action, preferring to manipulate their downfall while hidden in the background. 

[Edited from [url=http://www.dlsite.com/ecchi-eng/work/=/product_id/RE128642.html]DLsite English[/url]]
translation:
南条正人是一个没有朋友、胆小的家伙，经常被班上的女孩欺负。他得知了这些女孩的某些秘密，并决定现在是复仇的时候了。但他没有足够的信心采取直接行动，而是宁愿隐藏在幕后操纵他们的垮台。

[编辑自[url=http://www.dlsite.com/ecchi-eng/work/=/product_id/RE128642.html]DLsite英文[/url]]
